title: Machinery Mod
description: Dominate using war machines. Useful For PVP.
body:
Dominate using war machines.

Includes a Miner Bot , slowly brings destruction into the world by mining every underground block.


Includes a Giant Golem , the basic war machine

Includes the Guardian Golem , guards its owner at all costs.

Includes the Spirit Bomber , can be tamed and brings destruction over the world.

Includes Malware , Can only be spawned when a PC is crafted and used.
